name: Marcel
source:
"Marcel" is a visual novel about a pre-teen duck stuck on a retirement island for a whole week during summer break. His dad, Oliver, asks him to help with the management of the place. You'll have to run some errands, deliver the mail to the residents and get to know your neighbors.

[From [url=https://rick-lombric.itch.io/marcel]itch.io[/url]]
